llm.summary: AGNT was a watch-list name that was stopped out with a negative excess return, classified as an idiosyncratic break with clean process.
llm.root_cause: AGNT was a watch-list name that was stopped out with a negative excess return, classified as an idiosyncratic break with clean process.
llm.lesson: Watch-list entry failed due to a break, indicating the entry conditioning did not account for the risk.
llm.engines_credit: The watch-list signal was not sufficient to avoid a negative idiosyncratic event.
alternate_explanations: Real Estate sector weakness may have contributed to the break.
A company-specific catalyst caused the failure.
missing_evidence: Watch-list entry criteria and risk flags

signal_hypotheses.feature: Average prior 20-day volatility of watch-list names that break vs those that lift off
signal_hypotheses.measurement: Compare 20-day historical volatility pre-entry for broken vs successful watch names
signal_hypotheses.expected_direction: Broken names should have higher pre-entry volatility
signal_hypotheses.falsifier: If volatility is not higher, volatility is not a good conditioning variable for watch failures.
